description:
After being brutally murdered along with her family, Makina Hoshimura turns into a Shikabane Hime, a living corpse contracted to the Kougon Cult, in order to exert revenge on the mysterious undead organization responsible for her death. She is assisted in this task by Keisei Tagami, her contracted priest and former friend. This series follows the story of Keisei's younger brother Ouri, a boy with an unusual attraction to death, who slowly discovers his brother's secret and gets dragged into the world of the Shikabanes.

(Source: Wikipedia, edited)

node.description: After being brutally murdered along with her family, Makina Hoshimura turns into a Shikabane Hime, a living corpse contracted to the Kougon Cult, in order to exert revenge on the mysterious undead organization responsible for her death. She is assisted in this task by [Keisei Tagami](https://anilist.co/character/15612/Tagami-Keisei), her contracted priest and former friend.

Older brother of Ouri Kagami and Contracted Priest of Makina Hoshimura. He becomes Makina's Contracted Priest to help her attain her wish for a revenge against the Shichisei, a group of undead elites, who murdered her and her family.    He has no blood relation with Ouri, but he was the one who adopted him into the orphanage (after a terrible incident.). He always tries to protect Ouri by keeping him away from knowing the truth about Shikabane Himes and many abnormal incident - but seems that the incidents keep appearing before Ouri instead.

Having neither nature or attachment, she reigns rule over the shichisei as the strongest shikabane.     ~!It was later known that the shichiseis wanted to activate hokuto's powers without any sacrifice so got Makina to teach Hokuto's role: Makina's enemy. In the process, it is revealed that Hokuto was once a human sacrifice not knowing anything of the world thus her way of understanding things is to destroy it. She was born to be killed thus there was no reason for her death nor her revival making her the most powerful and deadliest tool among the antagonists.    She eventually became the betrayer monk's shikabane hime after destroying the being providing en for all the shikabane hime. Desperate and depressed of his former shikabane's death and the organizations' deception towards the monks, they work towards destroying shikabane.!~

At first a regular boy who coincidentally gets caught up in more than a few incidents involving the shikabanes. As Ouri's attachment to the dark side of death grows, he slowly learns the truth about his hidden past, the black cat, and the large organization behind the creation of shikabanes.

Takamasa's Shikabane Hime. She died in an automobile accident and came back with the regret of not living the life of a teenage girl. She bonded with Takamasa because she thought he was a powerful monk and would help her get to Heaven faster. Unfortunately, Takamasa knew nothing about the Shikabane Himes before that. Regardless, the two continued to work as a team.    Source: Wikipedia

The Shikabane Hime of Shuuji Isaki, her Contracted Priest. She has problems with Isaki - Isaki only treats her like a 'tool'.     ~!When her Contracted Priest was murdered by youngsters, she almost lost control of herself and turn into normal Corpse. She might had become Ouri's Shikabane Hime if Ouri stayed with her in the bar where Sadahiro opens , but Ouri left to distract the others (Not knowing that there was such a thing as 'passing contract'). In the end, Sadahiro had to 'dispose' her.!~
She uses either the Shotgun or Sniper rifle as her main weapon depending on situation.
Being the youngest shikabane introduced at only ten years old, she claims to be one of the stronger shikabanes having one of the ten as her contractor. Her weapon is a huge hammer-like spear.

A mysterious black cat that can at will been seen or unseen and also can be incorporeal.  It always seems to be around Kagami Ouri and he seems to be the only person the cat talks to.  It shows up at moments that involve the shikabane and shikabane hime, and gives Ouri clues about them.  The intention of this cat is unknown as to whether it is friend or foe.  The cat is identical to a pet that Ouri cherished as a child, which died after being run over by a vehicle.  Soon afterwards, this cat appeared.     ~!Near the end of the series, the cat revealed its true nature with the help of a foe shikabane who was once a fellow orphan along with Oori.  In fact they all are.  The cat was made up of a number of children who Oori's mother (shikabane) had kidnapped trying to fulfill her attachment to this world: to hold her child in her hands.  Later, the cat engulfed Oori in a monstrous form only to help him in the end later disappearing without a trace.!~

He is a priest in exile and known as the 'Auditor' - He is the only priest that has the authority to kill human beings with his Shikabane Hime, Akira Too'oka. He also master one of the Zandan skill and he is skill is equivalent Akasha Shishidou (known as the betrayal priest/monk).    He's specialty is using a dagger to cut down the enemy and his support power is to empower his Shikabane Hime's firing capability at any range.

Perhaps one of the pithiest villain after knowing the reason behind his betrayal against the Kougon Cult. In his youngest days, he was one of the top ace in the Cult. He was proud and strong in his faith, till one day - he was forced to kill his Shikabane Hime, who is his fiancee when she was alive.    After being forced to kill his own Shikabane Hime, he went into exile for 5 years. No news about him was heard till series of recent events - Resurrection of many Corpse cases.    The truth about the lies behind the promise of Shikabane Hime killing 108 corpse to ascend into heaven   ~!It is eternal condemnation of the soul instead.!~

Nozomi is a classmate of Ouri.

She and a few other students visited a "man-eating house", where she was attacked and injured by a group of corpses. She was saved by Makina, and since then she's developed a fascination with death.
A healer contractor who's combat ability is to attach her nerves as thread onto the enemy. With that, she is able to control the enemy at will
A little girl from the orphanage by Keisei Tagami .

He is the known to be the youngest and most talented priest. He is also the Contracted Priest and lover (as the series talks about their past) of Itsuki Yamagami. Itsuki wanted a priest who is the strongest to make contract, so she can enter heaven faster - and the answer is him (a student who is roughly 19 years in age at that time.)    His specialty is archery. With that, he provides support to Itsuki when she is on the killing mode.
The High Bishop and the Head of the Kougon Cult.
Riko takes care of Dairinkan's children along with Keisei.
A classmate of Ouri. She tends to be very observant and dreams of becoming the president of the student council.

Mitsuyoshi was once a student of the same school as Sumitori and a member of the kendo club. He was constantly teased by other students because of its uniqueness and therefore spent most of his time at home with video games and other activities on the computer.

Touya is one of the Shichisei; a tall character dressed properly in a white suit, with his head compromised of five balloons (the red one with six eyes being the "face"). His method of attacking is by exposing people's happiness and making it grow; he attaches a semi-invisible balloon by a person's neck to act as a container for their happiness, sending them into a daze and, if Touya wishes it so, makes them able to infect others the same way. The balloon then grows larger as the person experiences more happiness, and eventually pops, disclosing a hideous beast that devours the person in question. Touya is also able to levitate and teleport in balloon form, and when he speaks his voice sounds like it's been put through a sound distorter.     ~!Touya is actually not male at all, but a small girl hiding inside the white suit, holding the balloons that make Touya's head. She believes death to be the ultimate form of happiness, as she died on her first visit to an amusement park when she was little and thus joined the two feelings of joy and death together, thinking them to be the same thing.!~
Nicknamed as "Sword Hime," Kamika has been referred to as the strongest shikabane hime not necessarily for the level of her strength, but her regret and will.
Minai Ruo's contracted priest.
The contracted monk of Kamika and mentor of Keisei Tagami. One of the High Monks in the cult.

A J-Pop star who died of a heart disease. She became a Shikabane because she wanted to keep singing. Her manager used his mob connections to keep Osaki's death quiet, as well as any deaths that occur around her. She is angered when her song is interrupted or when someone does not listen to it. Her response to this is usually to kill the person who caused it. She can use her voice as a weapon.    (Source: Wikipedia)
A friend of Kagami, Ouri
Another classmate of Ouri's. Very innocent and oblivious to the world of Shikabane.

Hagino is known throughout the city that he lives with some women in a sort of harem. Now, however, were found some women's bodies that could be unambiguously assigned to this harem. But Hagino is long dead and has turned into a "Corpse" that has not yet left the world because he was too much of it devoted to women seem to possess.

The leader of the Shichisei and the one who are mainly Hokuto care. He is also responsible for Makina's death together with her parents. His goal is not only the world of humans is to liberate and destroy the Kougon cult, but Hazama pursuing yet another goal that directly relates to Makina and Hokuto
Ena was obsessed with beauty. His curse allows him to switch from one corpse to another, as long as they are nearby.
